findings.evidence: Across all 505 respondents (489 validly scored), matching our scorer with items 3, 5, 8, and 9 reversed produced 0 mismatches against pipeline_output.csv (compared to 499 mismatches when using the correct guide rule of 3, 5, 8, 9, and 10).
findings.description: The scoring pipeline omits item 10 (`rses_10`) from reverse coding, reversing only items 3, 5, 8, and 9 instead of the required items 3, 5, 8, 9, and 10 specified in the RSES scoring guide.
